_note: Reference photo -> room id map. Paths are relative to docs/photos-jpg/ (converted once from docs/Photos-1-001/*.heic by scripts/heic_to_jpg.py). The FIRST photo listed for a room is its primary reference — the one the critic judges from. Rooms with no photos are judged on the floor plan + Sims-4 dollhouse readability only. Later drops (docs/v3/) are converted with `python scripts/heic_to_jpg.py --src "docs/v3/<folder>" --name "<Room> v3"`, which numbers them in sorted source order because they arrived with camera-roll filenames.

1.name: Movie Room
1._note: v3 drop, 2026-08-22. v3 4 is the primary — 1200x1600 and the only shot of the whole room; v3 2 is the best single overview (TV wall, sectional and the stair together). v3 1 looks up the basement stair, which belongs to the stairwell, not this room. Everything else in the drop is 450x600 — do not meter sd from those, it is scale-inflated.

2.name: Arcade Room
2._note: v3 drop, 2026-08-22. v3 4 and v3 1 are the two 1200x1600 shots and between them cover both long walls; 4 is the primary — the arcade cabinet run is the room. The room is lit almost entirely by RGB cove and hex-panel fixtures, so every surface is colour-cast: read albedo off the neutral patches, never off a magenta-washed wall. 2 and 3 are 450x600 — layout only, no metering.
